add.name: gws-workflow
add.purpose: Cross-service Google Workspace workflows via the official gws CLI: standup reports, meeting prep, email-to-task, weekly digests across Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Tasks.
add.how_to_use: Install the gws CLI and authenticate with Google; invoke for multi-app Workspace automation. Repo ships ~95 per-service/recipe skills (gws-shared covers auth).
add.evidence: Official Google Workspace repo, 31k stars; skills.sh 32k installs (gws-gmail 79k); not present anywhere in the library
add.notes: Pick per-service skills (gws-calendar, gws-drive, gws-sheets) from the same repo as needed.

add.name: gws-gmail
add.purpose: Send, read, search and manage Gmail from the agent through the gws CLI, with sub-skills for triage, reply, forward and watch.
add.how_to_use: Requires gws CLI with Google OAuth; triggers on Gmail tasks.
add.evidence: Official Google Workspace repo, 31k stars; skills.sh 79k installs (most-installed gws skill)
add.notes: Sends real email: confirm before sending.
